prompt: Who was the last Miss World America to place in the Top 11 at Miss World? Hint: She has pursued a modeling career.
answer: The last was **Audra Diane Mari**, **Miss World America 2016**. She represented the United States at Miss World 2016, placing in the **Top 11**, and later pursued a career as a model and television host.
